# GitHub-style table of contents fixture

The anchor-guard specs (`tests/markdown-slug.spec.ts`, `tests/markdown-surface.spec.tsx`)
used the repo's own READMEs as their real-world document until the READMEs
dropped their tables of contents. This fixture carries the same shapes the
regression was about: emoji headings linked from a TOC, a U+FE0F variation
selector (`🖼️`), and a `&` that GitHub's slugger turns into a double dash.
